name: Azure (AKS) Plugin (WIP)
description: WIP: help appreciated. Node metadata, portal links, sign-in and cluster discovery. Pricing and cost cards are not implemented; real AKS verification is needed.

actions.title: Sign in to Azure for this cluster (az login)…

settings.label: Azure tenant (optional)
settings.help: A tenant id or domain for az login, when the account belongs to more than one tenant. Empty uses the default.

settings.label: Sign in with a device code
settings.help: Shows a code to enter in a browser, for a terminal without a browser. Off opens the browser.

settings.label: Extra variables for commands and terminals
settings.help: One NAME=value per line, added to the environment of the kubectl and helm commands, the terminals Klotse starts and Klotse's own connection for a cluster, for example AZURE_CONFIG_DIR=/path/to/dir. Saved as plain text in the settings file: do not put secrets here. Klotse's own connection to the cluster gets them too (the kubeconfig's sign-in helper), and they are never written to the kubeconfig or logs.

cluster_settings.label: Cloud of this cluster
cluster_settings.help: Set this when the cluster's nodes do not report their cloud in the providerID (a local emulator, a custom node pool). auto uses the providerID check; azure accepts this cluster's nodes without it.
